facts.text: Pacific's Four-Year Graduation Guarantee ensures that academically eligible undergraduates receive the course access necessary to graduate on time in four years.

sources.title: Private College Tuition Costs A Lot Less Than You May Think
sources.quote: Pacific's Four-Year Graduation Guarantee ensures that academically-eligible undergrads will receive the instruction necessary to graduate in four years, allowing them to launch their careers and start making an impact.
